title: docs(issue-authoring): scope the canonical-contract reference in contract.md to the source repository
body:
## Background

`skills/issue-authoring/references/contract.md`'s opening line states
it mirrors the canonical contract in `docs/issue-authoring-skill.md`
with no scoping note, while `SKILL.md`'s equivalent cross-reference is
explicitly scoped to "inside the source repository". An adopter
repository installs `contract.md` without any `docs/issue-authoring-skill.md`
file present at all, so the unscoped reference points at a document
that does not exist in that repository. An adopter's own reviewer
(GitHub Copilot) independently flagged this exact gap twice on the
same pull request.

## Proposed change

Add the same source-repository scoping note `SKILL.md` already uses to
`contract.md`'s reference, so an adopter reading the bundled contract
understands the referenced canonical document only exists in this
source repository, not in every installed bundle.

## Acceptance criteria

- `contract.md`'s reference to `docs/issue-authoring-skill.md` carries
  an explicit "inside the source repository" (or equivalent) scoping
  note, matching `SKILL.md`'s existing wording for the same reference.
- The canonical contract and its `.claude/skills/` mirror stay
  synchronized via `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply`, and
  `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes with no drift reported.
- `pnpm run lint:minimum` passes against the edited files.

## Candidate files

- `skills/issue-authoring/references/contract.md`
